settings.title: Edit Salt Minion Settings
settings.description: Configure master servers, minion identity, and connection options
settings.masterServersHint: Hostname or IP address of each Salt master. At least one is required for the minion to connect.
settings.minionIdHint: Unique identifier for this minion. Leave empty to use the system hostname.
settings.intervalHint: How often (in minutes) the minion checks in with the master. Range: 1–1440. Leave empty to use the default (60 min).
settings.hashHint: Hash used when discovering files on the master server.
settings.masterKeyUrlHint: URL containing the master's public key signature for auth reply verification. Leave empty to skip verification.
settings.sourceInterfaceHint: Network interface used to establish the connection to the master. Leave unset to use the default route.
